## About
Precise Auto Body is on Hollywood Blvd, between N. Wilton Pl. and N. Western Ave., close to the Hollywood Freeway. We handle everything from spot paint and dent removal to frame straightening and severe collision repair, with onsite mechanics and towing service too.
We know an accident throws your week off. Our job is to repair your vehicle the right way, the first time, and treat you with respect while we do it.
Customers often mention Mike and Angie by name, and say they answered their questions and helped them through the process. We're rated 4.6 from 71 Google reviews.

## Services
- Severe collision repair: Repair for heavier accident damage, including replaced bumpers and doors.
- Complete auto body paint: Full paint work to get your car looking right again.
- Precision color matching: Paint matched to your car's existing color.
- Automotive spot paint: Touch up paint for smaller damaged areas.
- Paintless dent removal: Dents taken out without repainting.
- Expert alignment services: Wheel alignment to keep your car driving straight after repairs.
- Professional detailing services: Cleaning inside and out. Reviewers mention their cars came back cleaned.

## FAQ
